title: From Learning Rates to Rotational Schedules: Finite-Horizon Theory on the Sphere
abstract: arXiv:2611.29579v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How should step sizes be scheduled across a finite training horizon? Cosine and warmup-stable-decay (WSD) schedules are widely adopted in large-scale pretraining, yet their effect on optimization also depends on parameter norms. Normalization can make parameter groups scale invariant, so that the loss depends only on their direction, while their norms still affect how fast the parameters rotate. In this work, we formulate schedule design directly in the space of rotational motion. Working within a geodesically convex spherical setting, we derive a last-iterate convergence guarantee for arbitrary rotational schedules that separates their overall scale from their distribution over time. We derive the unique schedule that minimizes this bound and prove that it approaches linear decay as the horizon grows. Empirically, our rotational interpretation and idealized spherical analysis provide useful predictions for LLM pretraining in practice,

translated_title: 从学习率到旋转调度：球面上的有限时域理论
translated_abstract: 在有限的训练时域内，步长应该如何调度？余弦调度和预热-稳定-衰减（WSD）调度在大规模预训练中被广泛采用，然而它们对优化的影响还依赖于参数范数。归一化可以使参数组具有尺度不变性，从而使得损失仅依赖于参数的方向，而参数的范数仍然会影响参数旋转的速度。在本工作中，我们直接在旋转运动的空间中表述调度设计。在测地凸的球面设置下，我们为任意旋转调度推导了最后一次迭代的收敛保证，该保证将调度的整体规模与其在时间上的分布分离开来。我们推导出了最小化该边界的唯一调度，并证明随着训练时域的增长，该调度趋近于线性衰减。在实证方面，我们的旋转解释和理想化的球面分析为实践中大语言模型的预训练提供了有用的预测。
tldr: 该论文将学习率调度设计重新表述为球面上的旋转调度问题，推导了任意旋转调度的最后一次迭代收敛保证，证明最优调度当时域增长时趋近于线性衰减，为大语言模型预训练实践提供了有用的理论指导。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates learning rate schedule design as rotational schedule design on the sphere, deriving a last-iterate convergence guarantee for arbitrary rotational schedules and proving that the unique optimal schedule approaches linear decay as the horizon grows, offering useful predictions for LLM pretraining in practice.
